tests.title: Send an approved template with two variables
tests.goal: Each variable is filled from its own Excel column.

steps.text: Map {{first_name}} -> 姓名 and {{event_date}} -> 活動日期
Click 發送到 WhatsApp and confirm
Check the message in Twilio and reply 會出席 on the phone

expected.text: Twilio shows "您好 QA Tester，提醒您 11月5日（三） 的活動，請問您會出席嗎？"
The reply 會出席 is recorded with a 會出席 filter chip

notes: As admin@tungwah.org on qa_event_reminder_357859 (approved), mapping first_name->姓名, event_date->活動日期. Twilio delivered '您好 QA Tester，提醒您 11月5日（三） 的活動，請問您會出席嗎？'. Tapped 會出席 -> recorded as btn_0 會出席; 回覆統計 shows 1 會出席 and a 會出席 filter chip. The first tap (10:48 UTC) was lost because Twilio posted it to the developer's tunnel (error 11200); after checking the sender webhook the message was resent once and the second tap was recorded.
